notes:
One new setting and one fix.

**Go to standby after.** A new reader setting that sends the tablet into standby after a chosen number of minutes without being used, so a tablet left on no longer runs its battery flat. Choose 15 to 120 minutes, or Never; press the power button to wake it. With two tablets, the second one follows the setting on the first. On most tablets this needs a permission Obbligato cannot ask for yet, and the setting says so when that is the case.

**The highlighter no longer leaves a trail on other tools.** After using the highlighter, placing a stamp or link or using the eraser could draw a brief highlighter stroke that then disappeared. It no longer does.

Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
